title: Provide the store to React
summary: React Redux Provider makes one store available to components under it.
introduction: React Redux Provider makes one store available to components under it. Your task: Find which part of the tree receives the store.
learningObjectives: Find which part of the tree receives the store.
Explain the example for provide the store to react

blocks.text: React Redux Provider makes one store available to components under it. Hooks can then read from that store.
Use a JavaScript project with @reduxjs/toolkit installed. React examples also need react-redux and React. These imports require your project build tool and are not available in the plain playground.

blocks.title: Provide the store to React

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: Provider wraps the part of the React tree that needs the store.
The store prop passes the existing store instance rather than creating a new one inside each child.

blocks.text: Components inside App can use React Redux hooks with the supplied store.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Create the store once for this client app. Do not recreate it on every component render.
